data.name: Settings_FastScan_Desc
data.value: Reads the drive's file table directly, so a whole drive is mapped in seconds instead of minutes. Windows asks for administrator permission once per scan; the app itself stays as it is. Say no and the normal scan runs, and you are not asked again until SpaceSharp restarts. Other file systems and single folders always use the normal scan.

data.name: Settings_HardLinks_Desc
data.value: Reads every file's link count so data with several names, such as Windows' WinSxS folder, is counted once. Slower on large drives.

data.name: Settings_LeaveOut_Desc

data.name: Settings_MergeChains_Desc

data.name: Settings_OutlinedLabels_Desc

data.name: Cleanup_SystemFiles_Note
data.value: hiberfil.sys, pagefile.sys and swapfile.sys. Windows manages them; SpaceSharp will not touch them.

data.name: Cleanup_SystemFiles_HowTo
data.value:
hiberfil.sys holds memory for hibernation and fast startup. To free it, open an administrator command prompt and run: powercfg /hibernate off
pagefile.sys and swapfile.sys are virtual memory. Their size is set under System › Advanced system settings › Performance › Virtual memory. Leaving them to Windows is the safe choice.

data.name: Cleanup_BrowserCaches_Note
data.value: {0:N0} cache folders, {1:N0} files. Pages load a little slower the first time after.

data.name: Cleanup_ShaderCaches_Note
data.value: {0:N0} folders, {1:N0} files. Games and drivers rebuild them on the next launch.
